description: ONS publishes a historical hourly classification of turbinable spilled energy for 2024 and 2025. The dictionary provides verified turbinable energy and components classified by energy-related and electricity-related causes, in MWh, with date and time. These quantities support studies of hydropower spill and dispatch constraints. The operator states that this historical product is no longer updated. It differs from the continuing reservoir-level turbinable-spill series and must not inherit that series refresh schedule. Coverage is hydropower spill classification in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
